11:["$","p",null,{"children":["The PEPM band is the PEO ladder, $79 Basic to $124 Plus, because that is the product this site compares; monthlyBase is 0 because both PEO tiers carry no base fee. The Payroll plan at $8 plus a $50 monthly base and EOR at $599 sit outside the band, as Remote and Oyster's non-HRIS products do. PEO Basic already includes payroll, tax filing, EPLI, state unemployment insurance administration, 401(k), commuter benefits, life and disability, standard HR consulting and 24/7 support. Plus is what adds access to medical, dental and vision insurance, health insurance administration, COBRA administration, mental health resources and health advocacy. Advanced time tracking ($8 per employee per month), dedicated HR consulting ($30 per employee per month, Basic and Plus only) and HSA/FSA access are paid add-ons on every plan, not bundled. PEO sign-up needs at least two W-2 employees; the Payroll plan has no stated headcount minimum."," The ledger applies a default ",["$","span",null,{"className":"uplift-pill","children":"12%"}]," annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the ",["$","$L3",null,{"href":"/line-items/renewal-uplift","children":"renewal-uplift"}]," page, not a vendor-published rate."]}]

13:["$","div","1",{"children":[["$","h3",null,{"className":"h3","children":"What does Plus add over Basic?"}],["$","div",null,{"children":["$","p",null,{"children":"Benefits. 14:["$","div","2",{"children":[["$","h3",null,{"className":"h3","children":"What additional fees sit on top?"}],["$","div",null,{"children":["$","p",null,{"children":"The paid add-ons are listed with their own rates: advanced time tracking at $8 per employee per month, dedicated HR consulting at $30 per employee per month (Basic and Plus only), international contractors at $39 per paid contractor per month, US-based contractors at $8 per paid contractor per month, EOR at $599 per employee per month (Basic and Plus only), and ICHRA health insurance reimbursements at $25 per enrolled employee per month.
